verifications.detail: ESPN scoreboard JSON for dates=20260921 lists event 401872947 (uid s:20~l:28~e:401872947) as STATUS_FINAL: away NYG 6 (0-3-3-0), home LAR 28 (7-7-7-7), SoFi Stadium, attendance 73773, startDate 2026-09-22T00:15Z, broadcast ESPN/ABC, week 2, and the league highlight clip is titled 'Rams take down Giants 28-6 on MNF'. That confirms both boundaries used by ingest.NBA_REG_OPENERS/NBA_REG_ENDS for 2025-26 from an external source (previously the end date was derived from the log's last full 30-team slate), and the log agrees: last 15-game slate 2026-04-12, play-in pairs from 2026-04-14.

verifications.claim: MIA@CHI 2026-01-08, GSW@MIN 2026-01-24, DEN@MEM 2026-01-25 and DAL@MIL 2026-01-25 were postponed.
verifications.detail: [checks_20260922_pass3.json] The Wikipedia 2025-26 NBA season article has a 'Postponed games' section listing exactly these four: Jan 8 Heat vs Bulls (condensation on the court), Jan 24 Warriors vs Timberwolves, and Jan 25 Nuggets vs Grizzlies plus Mavericks vs Bucks (January 2026 North American winter storm). NBA Communications confirms each ('Heat-Bulls game postponed', rescheduled Jan 29; 'Mavericks-Bucks game postponed'; 'Nuggets-Grizzlies game postponed') and Forbes adds that the Warriors game moved to Jan 25 on safety-and-security grounds in Minneapolis, with the Nuggets-Grizzlies makeup on Mar 18 and Mavericks-Bucks on Mar 31. All four 0-0 rows are now postponed with citations.
verifications.subject: NBA 2025-26 postponed fixtures (four games)

verifications.claim: CHA@LAL 2025-01-09, SAS@LAL 2025-01-11 and CHA@LAC 2025-01-11 were postponed.
verifications.detail: [checks_20260922_pass3.json] NBA Communications released 'Spurs-Lakers and Hornets-Clippers games postponed' (Jan 10 2025) and 'NBA postpones Hornets vs. Lakers game set for Jan. 9' -- all due to the Los Angeles wildfires. The Los Angeles Times reported the makeups: Hornets-Lakers played Feb 19 2025 and Clippers-Hornets played Mar 16 2025. The inherited log carries all three as 0-0 'finals', which is why CHA, LAL, LAC, SAS and NOP appeared with 83-84 games; they are now postponed rows with citations. Two further 0-0 rows in that season (HOU@ATL 2025-01-11 and MIL@NOP 2025-01-22) could NOT be matched to a published postponement notice in this pass: they are recorded as not played with verified=0 and flagged as unverified rather than assigned a reason.

verifications.claim: Every NBA Cup game counts toward the regular season except the championship, so the two finalists play 83 games.
verifications.detail: [checks_20260922_pass3.json] Sportico: 'The final is the lone game in the NBA Cup that does not count for a team's regular season record'; ESPN's Cup explainer: 'the teams that reach the NBA Cup's finale will actually play 83 games -- though the championship game won't count toward the standings'; Yahoo Sports and The Oklahoman repeat the rule. The inherited log corroborates it exactly: the championship rows are 2023-12-09 IND@LAL, 2024-12-17 MIL@OKC and 2025-12-16 SAS@NYK, and in each of those seasons precisely the two finalists carry one extra game (83) while every other team has 82. ingest.NBA_CUP_FINALS records the dates with the citation, flags the row in games.extra_json (nba_cup_championship), and the schedule-completeness check subtracts it instead of reporting a false over-length season.
verifications.subject: NBA Cup championship is excluded from the 82-game record

verifications.claim: NBAComp games.csv carries no game_type field, so PRE/REG/POST must be derived from verified season boundaries.
verifications.detail: [checks_20260922_pass3.json] Columns are game_id, season, game_date_et, tipoff_utc, away_team, home_team, away_score, home_score, status, source -- no type. The previous importer hardcoded REG for all 4,346 rows, so seasons 2023-24..2026-27 mixed exhibitions, regular season and playoffs and per-team counts reached 110. Boundaries are now derived (NBA_REG_OPENERS / NBA_REG_ENDS) with the evidence string stored on every row in games.verify_note and games.extra_json, so the derivation is auditable per row. NHL, by contrast, ships a real game_type column and needs no derivation.
verifications.subject: NBA inherited log has no game-type column

verifications.claim: MLB 2024 held 2429 regular-season games because the 2024-09-29 HOU@CLE finale was rained out and never made up.
verifications.detail: [checks_20260922_pass3.json] The database holds 2429 MLB 2024 R rows with CLE and HOU at 161 games and every other team at 162. The Wikipedia 2024 MLB season article and cleveland.com coverage of the game confirm the season finale at Progressive Field was called off after a 3h05m rain delay and was not rescheduled because it could not affect playoff qualification. Verified real-world deviation, recorded in EXPECTED_HISTORY['MLB']['known_short']['2024'].
verifications.subject: MLB 2024 regular season game count (2429 instead of 2430)

verifications.claim: NFL 2022 held 271 regular-season games because BUF@CIN (week 17, 2023-01-02) was suspended and declared a no contest.
verifications.detail: [checks_20260922_pass3.json] The database holds 271 NFL 2022 REG rows with BUF and CIN at 16 games and every other team at 17. ESPN, USA Today and league records confirm the week 17 Bills@Bengals game was suspended in the first quarter after Damar Hamlin's cardiac arrest on 2023-01-02, cancelled on 2023-01-05 and declared a no contest (never replayed; playoff seeding was adjusted instead). This is a verified real-world deviation, not a data gap: EXPECTED_HISTORY['NFL'] ['known_short']['2022'] records it so the schedule-completeness check reports it as investigated instead of as an error.
verifications.subject: NFL 2022 regular season game count (271 instead of 272)

verifications.claim: The 2026-27 NHL regular season is 84 games per team (1344 games), running 2026-09-29 to 2027-04-10.
verifications.detail: [checks_20260922_pass3.json] The inherited snapshot holds 1344 game_type=REG rows for season 20262027, which the PASS-2 log had called an anomaly against an assumed 82-game season (R-011). AP News (apnews.com/article/2026-27-nhl-schedule-c8fad72c8c8e17e937c95772ede211ca), TSN and the Wikipedia season article all confirm the new CBA made 2026-27 the first 84-game season since 1993-94: 1344 games, opening 2026-09-29, ending 2027-04-10, preseason cut to four games per team (2026-09-19..26, 65 games). The snapshot is CORRECT; R-011 is resolved and config.SEASON_LENGTH now carries the 84-game override so the schedule-completeness check stops flagging it.
verifications.subject: NHL 2026-27 regular season length
